entities.summary: Niels Rosenkrantz was a Danish-Norwegian statesman, diplomat and prime minister. He was the son of Otto Christian Rosenkrantz and Karen Johanne Rønning. He was an older brother of Marcus Gjøe Rosenkrantz.
